law: D1 - nothing is placed before its questions are answered by measurement (signed by Omer, 2026-11-12)
how: Per KIND of item: the questions a person walking in would ask. 'measure' names the measurement in dress-questions.js; min / max / is = the answer that passes. A question with no answer fails and the item is refused. stage 'after' = a question for the eye, answered from a picture after placing (the automatic eye is not built yet). Every fault found later adds a question here.

standing_person.text: Does the room fit the person (a cook in a kitchen, a gardener outdoors)?
Is there a floor under both feet, at this room's level?
Is the floor flat there (no step, ramp or stair)?
Is the nearest wall, glass or furniture at least 0.45 m away?
Is the person clear of every door and its swing (0.9 m)?
Can a person walk to this spot from a door?
Is every other person and floor item at least 0.5 m away?
Does the person leave the way open (not cut the walking area in two)?
Does the person face another person, or at least 1 m of open space (not a wall)?
Is the space empty from the feet to the head, against the real surfaces?
Is the spot lit, not a black corner?
Does the person look natural there in a picture?

seated_person.text: Is there a real chair there (found by its shape, not by its name)?
Is the chair free (nobody sits on it already)?
Does the chair stand on the floor (within 3 cm)?
Is there a seat under the body, 0.30 - 0.62 m above the floor?
Is there a floor under the chair?
Is every other person at least 0.4 m away?
Is the space of the upper body empty (no wall, column or shelf through it)?
Does the person look seated on the chair in a picture (not sunk, not hovering)?

floor_item.text: Is the item one thing of a normal size (not a kit of many, under 1.5 m wide)?
Is there a flat piece of wall to stand by?
Is there a floor under the whole item?
Is the floor flat under it?
Is it clear of every door and its swing (0.9 m)?
Is every person and other floor item at least 0.3 m away?
Can a person walk up to it from a door?
Is the nearest chair or table at least 0.4 m from it (room to pull a chair back)? Added 2026-11-12: a plant stood between the chairs of two tables.
Does it leave the way open (not cut the walking area in two)?
Is the space the item fills empty, against the real surfaces?
Does it look right there in a picture?

wall_item.text: Is its centre at eye level (1.2 - 1.9 m)?
Is there a wall in front of the room point, within 4.5 m?
Is the wall seen straight on (not at an angle)?
Is it one flat wall under the whole item (5 rays within 4 cm - the second building's walls carry a 3.4 cm step of their finish layer on every wall)?
Is it clear of every door, window and glass panel?
Is it clear of the other things already hung there?
Is the 25 cm in front of the wall empty there (no cabinet, TV or shelf)?
Does it hang straight and at a sensible place in a picture?

table_top_item.text: Does the furniture have the top the plan names?
Is the top flat under the item's base (within 2 cm)?
Is it clear of the other things already on this top?
Is the space above the top empty up to the item's height (no shelf above)?
Does it look right on this top in a picture?

table_setting.text: Does the table have chairs (found by their shape)?
Does every chair reach the table top (how many do not)?
Is there one setting in front of EVERY chair?
Is every piece fully on the table top (how many hang over the edge)?
Does any piece sit inside another piece (how many pairs)?
Is the table top empty in the model (nothing already on it)?
Does the table look laid like in a restaurant in a picture?

floor_finish.text: Is there a real floor under the point the plan names, and is the point free of walls?
Does the finish end ONLY at walls and doors (how many metres of its edge lie in open floor)? Added 2026-11-12: the dining oak was cut by a box, 9.2 m of its edge lay in open floor.
Does the finish reach a door (at least 0.6 m of its edge is a door)? A floor with no door is a closed pocket.
Is the area under the largest area the plan allows (the fill did not leak through an open door into the building)?
Does at least 98% of the finish lie on a floor surface that has baked light?
Does the change of floor look right at every door in a picture?

floor_grid.text: Is there one straight wall face at least 1.5 m long to lay the tiles from?
Do at least half of the walls of the room (by length) run along the tile grid or square to it?
Does a tile joint lie on the face of that wall, so a whole tile starts there (distance in metres)?
Do the joints run parallel to the walls in a picture, with no thin sliver of tile at the main wall?

ceiling_patch.text: Does the outline of one ceiling element surround the point (its own free edges, as a closed loop)?
Is part of that outline truly open - no other ceiling covers it (square metres, at least 0.05)?
Is the open part small (under 2 m2)? A large opening is a design (a void, a skylight), not a slip.
Is the material of the ceiling around it known, with its baked light?
Is the baked light at the corners of the outline alike (the spread, under 0.12)? A patch between very different lights would show.
Is the closed place unseen as a patch in a picture from below?

free_floor_item.text: Is there a floor under the whole item?
Is the floor flat under it?
Is it clear of every door and its swing (0.9 m)?
Is every person and other floor item at least 0.15 m away?
Can a person walk up to it from a door?
With everything already placed, does it leave a way 0.9 m wide open (not cut the walking area in two)? Sharpened 2026-11-13: a side table and a plant across a corridor left 0.5 m.
Is the space the item fills empty, against the real surfaces (its own box, turned as it is turned)?
Does it look right there in a picture?

seat_item.text: Is there a seat surface under the spot?
Is the seat 0.30 - 0.62 m above the floor (a seat, not an armrest or a table)?
Is the chair empty (nobody sits there, nothing lies there already)?
Does it lie on the seat in a picture (not sunk into it, not hovering)?

garden_item.text: Does the piece lie inside its planting bed (not over the paving)?
Is it clear of every door (0.9 m)?
Does it stand clear of the other pieces of the garden (the gap between their footprints, in metres)?
Is its space empty in the model (no table, chair or column through it)?
Does the bed read as a composed garden in a picture from above and from the side?

walking_person.text: Is the route at least 4 m long (shorter reads as pacing on the spot)?
Is every 25 cm of the route on floor a person can walk on (share of the samples)?
Is every leg of the route a free straight line (no wall, glass, closed door or furniture across it)?
Does the route pass every placed person and floor item by at least 0.3 m?
Do the feet stay on the floor and the turns look natural in a picture?

light_fill.text: Did the bake have NO ceiling lamp in this room (how many lamps)?
Is the room truly dark - its WALLS under 0.6 of the middle light of the walls of the building?
Is the room under a roof (the share of it that has a ceiling)? A terrace is lit by the sky.
Is it a room, not a shaft or a cupboard (at least 2.5 m2)?
Does the room read as lit, with no bright edge at its door, in a picture?

ground_finish.text: Does the model have a terrain (how many triangles)?
Is there a baked light picture of the ground - sun, sky and shadows - for this light set?
Does the ground read as lawn, road and paving with real shadows in a picture from above and at eye height?

ground_item.text: Is it the ground this thing grows or stands on (a shrub on the lawn, not on a road)?
Is the ground flat enough there (its slope in degrees)?
Does it stand clear of the building and of everything in the model - walls, roofs above, benches - by the distance the plan asks?
Is it as near to the building as the plan asks (a fern in the shade of a wall, a shrub by the building, not lost in a field)?
Does it stand clear of the other planted things (the gap left after the plan's own spacing, in metres)?
Does the baked light picture of the ground reach this spot (so it stands on lit ground, with its shadow)?
Does the planting read as grown there - no row, no plant on a path - in a picture from above and at eye height?
